measurement_host: macOS 13.7.8 x86_64, 16 logical cores, 16 GiB RAM
measurement_method: /usr/bin/time -l (macOS) for real/user/sys and maximum resident set size; resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss in-process for per-size isolation
ru_maxrss_unit_correction: On darwin, ru_maxrss is reported in BYTES. An initial reading that assumed KB overstated memory by ~1024x; all memory figures below are the corrected byte-unit measurements.

run_01_core_owner_suite.purpose: Route B / C11 / I03 / I05 / batch / bounded-runtime accepted owner tests, source-free

run_02_full_suite_minimal_deps.purpose: whole rawlsing_next/tests tree with only pytest available
run_02_full_suite_minimal_deps.interpretation: These are ENVIRONMENTAL collection errors, not runtime defects.

run_03_full_suite_with_optional_deps.purpose: same tree after installing pandas and pyarrow into the isolated venv
run_03_full_suite_with_optional_deps.wall_vs_cpu_anomaly: 65.24s wall against only 4.09s user CPU. The gap is interpreter/import and collection cost, NOT compute. Recorded as measured, not explained away.

run_04_05_full_suite_bounded.purpose: whole suite executed to completion under a per-test timeout so that slow tests surface rather than hang the run
run_04_05_full_suite_bounded.IMPORTANT: An earlier unbounded invocation of this same suite exceeded a 120s command ceiling and was terminated. That is a harness-level observation about run cost, recorded here; it is not a repo defect.

failure_taxonomy_of_the_58_failures_and_.method: grep of the 'E ' assertion lines in the run log, deduplicated and SHA-masked

failure_taxonomy_of_the_58_failures_and_.honesty_note: These counts are a deduplicated histogram of assertion lines, not a per-test adjudication. This commission did not adjudicate each of the 58 failures and does not claim they are all benign.

harness_execution.corrections_made_during_execution: Three probes initially reported FAIL due to harness defects, not owner defects: (P07) two byte-identical manifests were constructed so the stale-manifest test was vacuous; (P08) the receipt hash is not a member of UnitExecutionReceipt.projection() so the string replacement was a no-op; (P17) the expectation was wrong because checkpoint identity is visit-order-sensitive. Each was diagnosed, corrected and re-executed. No owner source was changed to obtain a PASS.

time_scaling_in_process.observation: per-unit cost is flat within ~3% across a 64x size increase. LINEAR, not superlinear.
time_scaling_in_process.caveat: in-process, synthetic executor, single manifest. This bounds ORCHESTRATION cost only. It is NOT a forecast of any real 35-wave workload.

memory_scaling_isolated_processes.method: one fresh interpreter per size; ru_maxrss in bytes (darwin semantics)
memory_scaling_isolated_processes.observation: roughly LINEAR memory at ~6.2 KB per manifest unit, dominated by the immutable BatchManifest plus retained receipts. 200k units reached ~1.17 GiB and ~48s.
memory_scaling_isolated_processes.caveat: measured to 200k units only. Extrapolation beyond that is NOT claimed.

source_free_owner_suite.evidence: 178/178 passed in 4.44s wall, 32.78 MiB peak RSS, 4.01s user CPU

whole_suite.evidence: 3216 passed / 58 failed / 15 errors in 18m08s wall, 1.49 GiB peak RSS; 17 tests exceed 60s

batch_orchestration.evidence: ~145-149 us/unit orchestration; ~6.2 KB/unit resident; FULL_MANIFEST_COVERAGE at every size tested up to 200k units

durable_checkpoint_envelope.evidence: zero file-write operations across pre553_batch_runner, pre553_replay_audit, pre553_c11_repository, pre553_c11_integrity, pre553_route_b_production, bounded_empirical_runtime, pre553_discovery_adaptive
durable_checkpoint_envelope.consequence: process-loss recovery is CALLER-OWNED. See 03_RESTART_CANCELLATION_CACHE_TESTS.json and finding F-01.
